context: Future work. The most natural development of our work would be to extend Santocanale’s work to the multiplicative case in order to obtain a circular presentation of full µMALLP. By doing so, we can hope to sharpen our completeness result on EFD by extended it to regular designs for which we conjecture a similar completeness theorem can be achieved. Another very interesting research direction would be to investigate under which conditions we can obtain a full abstraction result for our semantics. Acknowledgments.
